# Security policy

## Supported versions

The repository does not yet contain a released application. Security fixes apply to the current `main` branch until versioned releases exist.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue containing exploit details, credentials, customer information or employee data. Prefer GitHub's private vulnerability-reporting or Security Advisory flow for this repository. If that is unavailable, contact the repository owner privately and share only the minimum information needed to establish a secure reporting channel.

Include the affected component, reproduction conditions, likely impact and any safe mitigation. Do not access data or systems beyond what you own or are expressly authorised to test.

## Response expectations

The maintainer will acknowledge a valid private report, assess severity and scope, track remediation on a private branch when necessary and publish an appropriate advisory after a fix is available. No response-time or bounty commitment is currently offered.
